batch_label: Fix — shipvault hull numbers and delivery years (2026-09-22 sweep leads)
reason: The 2026-09-22 sweep of all 212 backend rows citing a shipvault page compared every shipvault-cited cell against the unit record the page loads. Five value defects survived triage: one wrong hull number on a row that cites the very record contradicting it (live row 1054, §3.8c), three 'Hull Unknown NN' placeholders whose hull numbers the record now carries (live rows 1075-1077), and two delivery years the record moves a year later (live rows 1076/1077, §4.18/§4.19). Live row 1078 keeps its placeholder (shipvault carries no hull number for it: name 'HULL 4', yardno 'NA'), and live row 937 (Al Sadaf) is left alone - shipvault's built=2026 is contradicted by its own delivered=2025-12-10 and by IGU 2026, which prints delivery 2025 for IMO 9972957, so the backend's 2025 stands.
